The present petition has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 [corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973], seeking quashing of FIR No. 529/2025 dated 09.12.2025, registered at Police Station K.N. Katju Marg, District Rohini,
New Delhi, under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, alongwith all consequential proceedings arising therefrom 2.
Issue notice.
Ms. Manjeet Arya, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Mr. Aditya Chaudhary, learned counsel, accepts notice on behalf of the prosecutrix.
3. The FIR concerns an allegation of rape on the false pretext of marriage.

Mr. Dhananjai Jain,
learned counsel for the petitioner, submits This is a digitally signed order.

Mr. Jain draws my attention to a judgment of the Supreme Court in Naim Ahamed v.
